notes_for_editor: Thin-to-moderate evidence: only LighthouseFriends and Lighthouse Digest (both modern, copyrighted, secondary) plus Parks Canada; Dept of Marine reports predate Newfoundland's union and were not applicable; no newspapers searched. Conflicts stated in text: first light 1810/1813; U-boat attack 1941 vs 1942; Robert Sheppard left 1938/1939; Leo Power head keeper 1952/1953; stone tower demolition. Lighthouse Friends gives plaque ceremony 20 Aug 1970, Lighthouse Digest 29 Aug 1970 (omitted). Lighthouse Friends says NHS designated 1951; omitted. Record's 2014 heritage designation not confirmed (statement dated Oct 2013). Current access, ownership not verified from CCG List of Lights. Austin Sheppard assistant start 1855 is approximate (LF ties it to the 1855 lens). Story's 1892 boat sentence and 1943 Power dates not independently confirmed. Fact-check 2026-10-27: fort-name disagreement (Jeffrey vs William Amherst) added; access and owner now from Lighthouse Friends; agency changed from Fisheries and Oceans to Canadian Coast Guard per LF. Tea room location differs (LF: shed east of lighthouse; LD: old drill house).
